**Logs and screenshots**
If you saw an error, attach the newest file from the `Logs` folder in NetPad's app data folder
(shown in Help > About, by default `%LOCALAPPDATA%\NetPad` on Windows, `~/.local/share/NetPad` on
Linux, `~/Library/Application Support/NetPad` on macOS). Check it for anything private first.
Screenshots help with UI bugs.
